newspaper.line: Write down on these tears of newspaper
stanza: Write down on these tears of newspaper
Words you would like to see disappear
Let ash fly above the rusty stovetop
I’m going to start with the word “sincere”
I just read that there was an asteroid
Went between the Moon and the Earth

skyscraper.line: Drop some cold butter on 'em from the skyscraper
skyscraper.linePrev: Give 'em rock bottoms and a cold stone stunner
skyscraper.lineNext: Pistol whip 'em with the handle of a lightsaber

wallpaper.line: I could tell you things about this wallpaper
stanza: You can't just shoot your way out and go
I could tell you things about this wallpaper
That you'd never ever want to know
